title: Fix keybind category label
description: Keybind category shows translation key instead of human-readable text. Add a constant ("Beautiful Day Counter") for the display name in the main mod class and ensure the client keybinding category uses it.

title: Add mod menu icon for Beautiful Day Counter
description: Ship a 256x256 (or scaled) mod icon on the Beautiful Day Counter Mod Menu entry so players see branded art on the detail pane.
notes: Design or source a 256x256 texture and hook Mod Menu API to display it on the mod detail screen.

title: Expose HUD toggle hotkey in Controls menu
description: Register a Fabric keybinding category for Beautiful Day Counter so players can rebind the HUD toggle in the Controls screen.
notes: HUD toggle now shows in Controls via dedicated category.

title: Plan survival tracking for non-hardcore worlds
description: Design how Beautiful Day Counter should track and reset survival streaks for non-hardcore players.
notes: Figure out how to store last-death tick locally/client-side, how to sync from server, and how UI should surface the post-death day count.

title: Show 'Survived N days' on death screen
description: Hook the death screen UI so hardcore players see how many in-game days they survived.
notes: Death screen now renders "Survived Day N" overlay with difficulty/game-mode context via PostMortemOverlay + DeathScreen mixin (commit d8a1085).
